title: Examples
lede: Concrete calls you can copy, paste, and hand to your own AI to wire up an integration.
body:
At a glance
  • Discover engines.
  • Synthesize inline and queued.
  • Poll and download audio.

Discover engines

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
     http://127.0.0.1:8123/api/v1/tts/engines

Synthesize

curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8123/api/v1/tts/synthesize \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text": "Chapter one.", "voice": "gravel-road"}'

Poll & download (long text)

# returns {"job_id":"abc","poll":"/api/v1/tts/jobs/abc"}
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" http://127.0.0.1:8123/api/v1/tts/jobs/abc
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -o out.wav \
     http://127.0.0.1:8123/api/v1/tts/jobs/abc/audio
